description: This file contains core functions related to file checkout procedures in a version control system, including directory creation and removal, file reading and writing, handling of symbolic links, submodules, and cache entries, with functions managing the checkout process at a low level.

methods.name: void create_directories(const char * path,int path_len,const struct checkout * state)
methods.description: Creates a nested directory structure based on the provided path, handling existing directories and symlinks, with error handling.

methods.name: void remove_subtree(struct strbuf * path)
methods.description: Recursively removes a directory subtree, including all files and subdirectories.

methods.name: int create_file(const char * path,unsigned int mode)
methods.description: Creates a new file with specified mode and flags.

methods.name: void * read_blob_entry(const struct cache_entry * ce,size_t * size)
methods.description: Reads a blob object from the repository database based on a cache entry, returning the data and size.

methods.name: int open_output_fd(char * path,const struct cache_entry * ce,int to_tempfile)
methods.description: Opens a file descriptor for writing, possibly creating a temporary file or a regular file based on parameters.

methods.name: int fstat_checkout_output(int fd,const struct checkout * state,struct stat * st)
methods.description: Performs a reliable fstat on a file descriptor if conditions are met, to obtain file info.

methods.name: int streaming_write_entry(const struct cache_entry * ce,char * path,struct stream_filter * filter,const struct checkout * state,int to_tempfile,int * fstat_done,struct stat * statbuf)
methods.description: Streams a blob to a file descriptor, with optional filtering, and manages output path handling.

methods.name: void enable_delayed_checkout(struct checkout * state)
methods.description: Initializes delayed checkout state to defer certain file operations.

methods.name: int finish_delayed_checkout(struct checkout * state,int show_progress)
methods.description: Completes the delayed checkout process, applying filters, handling progress display, and finalizing files.

methods.name: void update_ce_after_write(const struct checkout * state,struct cache_entry * ce,struct stat * st)
methods.description: Updates cache entry metadata after a file write, including stat info and invalidation of fsmonitor.

methods.name: int write_entry(struct cache_entry * ce,char * path,struct conv_attrs * ca,const struct checkout * state,int to_tempfile,int * nr_checkouts)
methods.description: Writes a cache entry to the filesystem, handling different file modes, symlinks, submodules, and conversion to working tree format.

methods.name: int check_path(const char * path,int len,struct stat * st,int skiplen)
methods.description: Checks and returns lstat on a path, refusing to follow symlinks if appropriate.

methods.name: void mark_colliding_entries(const struct checkout * state,struct cache_entry * ce,struct stat * st)
methods.description: Marks cache entries as matched if they collide in the working directory or index, considering paths and inode info.

methods.name: int checkout_entry_ca(struct cache_entry * ce,struct conv_attrs * ca,const struct checkout * state,char * topath,int * nr_checkouts)
methods.description: Performs a checkout of a cache entry to a target path, with handling for existing files, directories, submodules, and collision cases.

methods.name: void unlink_entry(const struct cache_entry * ce,const char * super_prefix)
methods.description: Unlinks a cache entry from the working directory, handling submodules and directory cleanup.

methods.name: int remove_or_warn(unsigned int mode,const char * file)
methods.description: Removes a file or directory, warning on failure; special handling for submodules.

methods.name: int string_is_not_null(struct string_list_item * item,void * data UNUSED)

ctags.signature: (struct cache_entry * ce,struct conv_attrs * ca,const struct checkout * state,char * topath,int * nr_checkouts)
